briefings.headline: Stay disciplined against Wheeler; attack strikes
briefings.message: Zack Wheeler is the high-confidence opposing starter. Lefties, be ready to drive a breaking ball; Yordan Alvarez owns a .521 xwOBA against that group. Righties, look for fastballs and make him work in the zone—do not chase his splitter, sweeper, or curveball. If he exits, watch for rested Orion Kerkering and available lefties Brooks Raley and José Alvarado; closer Jhoan Duran is limited after pitching yesterday.
reminders: Alvarez stays in the lineup despite the rest suggestion.
Righties: hunt fastballs; avoid expanding against breaking balls.
Late left-handed relievers to watch: Raley and Alvarado.

reminders: Keep Javier off predictable fastball counts, especially against Schwarber and Harper.

Bryan King, Enyel De Los Santos, and AJ Blubaugh are limited after yesterday’s work.
